development.usageZh: 名词：发展 with the development of。动词 develop。

examples.sentence: The town saw slow development.
examples.trans: 这座镇发展缓慢。

examples.sentence: App development ate the evening.
examples.trans: 应用开发吃掉了晚上。

examples.sentence: With the development of cheap data, night buses still vanished.
examples.trans: 随着便宜流量的发展，夜班车仍消失了。

examples.sentence: Development that cannot fund a tap is only a skyline.
examples.trans: 资助不了水龙头的发展，只是天际线。

examples.sentence: They praised development and billed the clinic later.
examples.trans: 他们赞美发展，稍后给诊所开账单。

examples.sentence: A development of attention markets will develop sleepless children.
examples.trans: 注意力市场的发展，会培养睡不着的孩子。

convenient.usageZh: 形容词：方便的 a convenient app。名词 convenience。副词 conveniently。

examples.sentence: This shop is convenient.
examples.trans: 这家店很方便。

examples.sentence: A convenient click still needs a signature.
examples.trans: 方便的点击仍需要签名。

examples.sentence: The app is convenient until the refund button hides.
examples.trans: 退款按钮一藏，应用就不方便了。

examples.sentence: Convenient delivery is inconvenient for the rider at midnight.
examples.trans: 方便的配送对午夜骑手并不方便。

examples.sentence: They sold convenient lives and inconvenient contracts.
examples.trans: 他们出售方便的生活和不方便的合同。

examples.sentence: Convenience that cannot be refused is a kind of trap.
examples.trans: 无法拒绝的方便，是一种陷阱。

purchase.usageZh: 可作名词/动词：购买 make a purchase；purchase a ticket。

examples.sentence: I purchased a ticket.
examples.trans: 我买了一张票。

examples.sentence: The purchase arrived wet.
examples.trans: 购买的东西湿着到了。

examples.sentence: She purchased insurance after the leak.
examples.trans: 泄漏之后她买了保险。

examples.sentence: One-click purchase hides the hours of the warehouse.
examples.trans: 一键购买藏起仓库的钟点。

examples.sentence: They purchased attention with a bright thumbnail.
examples.trans: 他们用亮缩略图购买注意力。

examples.sentence: A purchase you cannot refund is a small treaty.
examples.trans: 无法退款的购买是一份小条约。

application.usageZh: 名词：申请 / 应用程序 fill in an application；a job application。动词 apply。

examples.sentence: Fill in the application.
examples.trans: 填写申请。

examples.sentence: The application crashed at pay.
examples.trans: 付款时应用崩溃了。

examples.sentence: Her job application named night hours.
examples.trans: 她的求职申请点出了夜班。

examples.sentence: An application that tracks you is not a toy.
examples.trans: 追踪你的应用不是玩具。

examples.sentence: They rejected the application because the photo smiled too little.
examples.trans: 他们拒绝申请，因为照片笑得太少。

examples.sentence: Application forms collect more than they return.
examples.trans: 申请表收集的比归还的多。

register.usageZh: 动词：注册 register an account。名词 registration。

examples.sentence: Register before Friday.
examples.trans: 周五前注册。

examples.sentence: She registered with an old email.
examples.trans: 她用旧邮箱注册。

examples.sentence: He registered the complaint and waited three weeks.
examples.trans: 他登记了投诉，等了三周。

examples.sentence: To register is easy; to delete the account is a maze.
examples.trans: 注册很容易；删除账户是迷宫。

examples.sentence: They registered users as data, then as friends.
examples.trans: 他们把用户先登记成数据，再登记成朋友。

examples.sentence: A registered life can still miss a bus.
examples.trans: 登记过的生活仍可能错过一班车。

deliver.usageZh: 动词：递送 deliver a parcel。名词 delivery。

examples.sentence: They deliver rice at dawn.
examples.trans: 他们黎明送米。

examples.sentence: The rider delivered the soup cold.
examples.trans: 骑手把汤冷着送到。

examples.sentence: Can the speech deliver a tap, not only a slogan?
examples.trans: 演讲能送出一个水龙头，而不只是口号吗？

examples.sentence: Night delivery writes on the rider's knees.
examples.trans: 夜间配送写在骑手的膝盖上。

examples.sentence: They promised to deliver tomorrow and meant a week.
examples.trans: 他们答应明天送到，意思是一周。

examples.sentence: What gets delivered is often cheaper than who delivers.
examples.trans: 被送到的东西，常常比送的人更便宜。

refund.usageZh: 名词/动词：退款 a full refund；refund the money。

examples.sentence: Ask for a refund.
examples.trans: 要求退款。

examples.sentence: The shop refunded the wet book.
examples.trans: 商店退了湿书的钱。

examples.sentence: A non-refundable fee hid in the last box.
examples.trans: 不可退款的费用藏在最后一个框里。

examples.sentence: They refunded the money and not the hours of waiting.
examples.trans: 他们退了钱，没退等候的钟点。

examples.sentence: Refund buttons that wander are a design, not an accident.
examples.trans: 会走丢的退款按钮是设计，不是意外。

examples.sentence: A refund is the rare honest sentence in a purchase.
examples.trans: 退款是购买里罕见的诚实句子。

insurance.usageZh: 不可数名词为主：保险 travel/health insurance。动词 insure。

examples.sentence: Buy travel insurance.
examples.trans: 买旅行保险。

examples.sentence: The insurance skipped the leak.
examples.trans: 保险跳过了泄漏。

examples.sentence: Health insurance arrived after the night cough.
examples.trans: 夜咳之后健康保险才到。

examples.sentence: They sold insurance in an app that crashed in storms.
examples.trans: 他们在风暴里会崩溃的应用里卖保险。

examples.sentence: Insurance that will not name floods is weather theatre.
examples.trans: 不肯点名洪水的保险是天气戏剧。

examples.sentence: A cheap premium is expensive when the clause is a maze.
examples.trans: 条款是迷宫时，便宜保费很贵。

reservation.usageZh: 名词：预订 make a reservation。动词 reserve。

examples.sentence: I made a reservation.
examples.trans: 我订了位。

examples.sentence: The reservation vanished at midnight.
examples.trans: 预订在午夜消失了。

examples.sentence: A reservation is not a room if the key never comes.
examples.trans: 钥匙不来，预订就不是房间。

examples.sentence: They overbooked reservations and called it demand.
examples.trans: 他们超售预订，称之为需求。

examples.sentence: Keep the reservation number on paper.
examples.trans: 把预订号留在纸上。

examples.sentence: A reservation that can be cancelled by an algorithm is a maybe.
examples.trans: 能被算法取消的预订只是“也许”。

appointment.usageZh: 名词：预约 make an appointment。

examples.sentence: I have an appointment at nine.
examples.trans: 我九点有预约。

examples.sentence: The appointment slipped by two hours.
examples.trans: 预约滑了两小时。

examples.sentence: A clinic appointment is a kind of hope with a chair.
examples.trans: 诊所预约是带着椅子的希望。

examples.sentence: They sold same-day appointments and staffed yesterday.
examples.trans: 他们卖当天预约，人员却按昨天排。

examples.sentence: Missed appointments often mean missed buses, not missed character.
examples.trans: 错过预约常常意味着错过公交车，不是错过品格。

examples.sentence: An appointment screen that cannot call back is a closed door.
examples.trans: 不能回拨的预约屏幕是一扇关着的门。

accommodation.usageZh: 名词：住宿 find accommodation。动词 accommodate。

examples.sentence: We found cheap accommodation.
examples.trans: 我们找到便宜住宿。

examples.sentence: The accommodation had wifi and no water.
examples.trans: 住宿有无线网，没有水。

examples.sentence: Student accommodation far from the bus is a night tax.
examples.trans: 远离公交车的学生住宿是夜间税。

examples.sentence: They photographed accommodation in daylight and rented it at 2 a.m. noise.
examples.trans: 他们在白天拍住宿，按凌晨两点噪音出租。

examples.sentence: Accommodation that cannot hold a suitcase still holds a contract.
examples.trans: 装不下箱子的住宿仍装着合同。

examples.sentence: To accommodate a guest is more than a lock box.
examples.trans: 容纳客人，不只是一个密码锁盒。

reliable.usageZh: 形容词：可靠的 a reliable rider。名词 reliability。副词 reliably。

examples.sentence: This clock is reliable.
examples.trans: 这时钟可靠。

examples.sentence: A reliable bus matters more than a new app.
examples.trans: 可靠的公交车比新应用更要紧。

examples.sentence: The site is reliable until you need a human.
examples.trans: 你需要人的时候，网站就不可靠了。

examples.sentence: They called the rider unreliable and not the map.
examples.trans: 他们说骑手不可靠，不说地图。

examples.sentence: Reliable reviews are slower than trending ones.
examples.trans: 可靠评论比热门评论慢。

examples.sentence: Reliability is a timetable, not a brand colour.
examples.trans: 可靠是时刻表，不是品牌色。

benefit.usageZh: 名词/动词：益处 benefit from an app。形容词 beneficial。

examples.sentence: The app has one benefit: a map.
examples.trans: 这应用有一个益处：地图。

examples.sentence: Who benefits from a free trial that never ends?
examples.trans: 谁从永不结束的免费试用中受益？

examples.sentence: Night data benefits the platform more than the student.
examples.trans: 夜间流量让平台比学生更受益。

examples.sentence: A benefit hidden in small print is a trap.
examples.trans: 藏在小字里的益处是陷阱。

examples.sentence: They listed benefits and skipped the refund maze.
examples.trans: 他们列出益处，跳过退款迷宫。

examples.sentence: Mutual benefit on a screen can still be a one-way camera.
examples.trans: 屏幕上的互利仍可能是单向相机。

arrange.usageZh: 动词：安排 arrange a meeting。名词 arrangement。

examples.sentence: Please arrange a chair.
examples.trans: 请安排一把椅子。

examples.sentence: She arranged the delivery for dawn.
examples.trans: 她把配送安排在黎明。

examples.sentence: He arranged a call and the app ate the number.
examples.trans: 他安排了通话，应用吃掉了号码。

examples.sentence: Arranged convenience often rearranges someone else's night.
examples.trans: 被安排的方便，常常重新安排别人的夜。

examples.sentence: They arranged insurance after the storm, not before.
examples.trans: 他们在风暴后而不是之前安排保险。

examples.sentence: To arrange a life in an app is to forget the stairwell.
examples.trans: 把生活安排进应用，就是忘掉楼梯间。

official.usageZh: 形容词/名词：官方的 official notice；an official。副词 officially。

examples.sentence: Read the official notice.
examples.trans: 读官方通知。

examples.sentence: The official fee was smaller than the hidden one.
examples.trans: 官方费用比隐藏费用小。

examples.sentence: Officially the refund exists; in the menu it does not.
examples.trans: 官方说退款存在；菜单里没有。

examples.sentence: An official smile on the site cannot hold a flood.
examples.trans: 网站上的官方微笑托不住洪水。

examples.sentence: They waited for official news while the street already knew.
examples.trans: 他们等官方消息，街上已经知道了。

examples.sentence: Unofficial hours still happen after official closing time.
examples.trans: 官方打烊之后，非官方钟点仍在发生。

avoid.usageZh: 动词：避免 avoid + doing / avoid sth。

examples.sentence: Avoid wet wires.
examples.trans: 避开湿电线。

examples.sentence: She avoids clicking the bright button at night.
examples.trans: 她避免晚上点那个亮按钮。

examples.sentence: He avoided the refund maze by paying in the shop.
examples.trans: 他在店里付钱，避开退款迷宫。

examples.sentence: Avoiding sleep to keep a streak is a designed trap.
examples.trans: 为了保持连续天数而避开睡眠，是设计好的陷阱。

examples.sentence: They avoided naming the rider and named the weather.
examples.trans: 他们避免点名骑手，点名了天气。

examples.sentence: Some fees are avoidable; the maze is the product.
examples.trans: 有些费用可避免；迷宫才是产品。

experience.usageZh: 名词/动词：经历 work experience；experience a delay。形容词 experienced。

examples.sentence: She has little experience.
examples.trans: 她经验不多。

examples.sentence: They experienced a three-hour delay.
examples.trans: 他们经历了三小时延误。

examples.sentence: User experience hid the unsubscribe button.
examples.trans: 用户体验藏起了退订按钮。

examples.sentence: Experience of night delivery does not show in the star rating.
examples.trans: 夜间配送的经验不显示在星级里。

examples.sentence: An experienced instructor still lost the file in the cloud.
examples.trans: 有经验的讲师仍把文件丢在云里。

examples.sentence: Lived experience is slower than a trending clip.
examples.trans: 亲身经历比一条热门片段慢。

various.usageZh: 形容词：各种各样的 various apps。副词 variously。名词 variety。

examples.sentence: She tried various apps.
examples.trans: 她试了各种应用。

examples.sentence: Various fees appeared at checkout.
examples.trans: 结账时出现了各种费用。

examples.sentence: The platform hosts various voices and one ranking.
examples.trans: 平台托管各种声音和一个排名。

examples.sentence: Various reviews can still be bought in bundles.
examples.trans: 各种评论仍可以成捆买。

examples.sentence: They offered various plans and one maze.
examples.trans: 他们提供各种套餐和一个迷宫。

examples.sentence: Variety without a refund is only a catalogue.
examples.trans: 没有退款的多样性只是目录。

attention.usageZh: 不可数名词：注意力 pay attention to。动词 attend。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to the road.
examples.trans: 注意路。

examples.sentence: The thumbnail stole her attention at dinner.
examples.trans: 缩略图在晚饭时偷走了她的注意。

examples.sentence: Attention is sold by the second and paid for in sleep.
examples.trans: 注意力按秒出售，用睡眠来付。

examples.sentence: They designed for attention, not for leaving.
examples.trans: 他们为注意力设计，不为离开设计。

examples.sentence: A child's attention is not an infinite scroll.
examples.trans: 孩子的注意力不是无限滚动。

examples.sentence: If a platform lives on attention, rest will look like a bug.
examples.trans: 如果平台靠注意力活，休息会看起来像故障。

edit.usageZh: 动词：编辑 edit a video。名词 editor / edition。

examples.sentence: Please edit the title.
examples.trans: 请编辑标题。

examples.sentence: She edited out the leak and kept the sunset.
examples.trans: 她剪掉泄漏，留下日落。

examples.sentence: He edits comments until only praise remains.
examples.trans: 他编辑评论，直到只剩称赞。

examples.sentence: An edited life is easier to sell than a stairwell.
examples.trans: 剪过的生活比楼梯间更好卖。

examples.sentence: They edited the instructor's pause into 'energy'.
examples.trans: 他们把讲师的停顿剪成“能量”。

examples.sentence: What we cannot edit is the body after midnight.
examples.trans: 我们无法编辑的，是午夜之后的身体。

attractive.usageZh: 形容词：吸引人的 an attractive thumbnail。动词 attract。名词 attraction。

examples.sentence: The cover looks attractive.
examples.trans: 封面看起来吸引人。

examples.sentence: An attractive price hid a monthly trap.
examples.trans: 吸引人的价格藏着按月陷阱。

examples.sentence: Attractive faces on a platform are often a lighting budget.
examples.trans: 平台上吸引人的脸常常是灯光预算。

examples.sentence: They made the refund unattractive on purpose.
examples.trans: 他们故意让退款看起来不吸引人。

examples.sentence: What is attractive at 1 a.m. may be a design against sleep.
examples.trans: 凌晨一点吸引人的，可能是反睡眠的设计。

examples.sentence: Attractive is not the same as true, or kind.
examples.trans: 吸引人不等于真，也不等于善。

platform.usageZh: 名词：平台 / 站台 a video platform；a train platform。

examples.sentence: Wait on the platform.
examples.trans: 在站台上等。

examples.sentence: The platform changed the rules at dawn.
examples.trans: 平台在黎明改了规则。

examples.sentence: A platform that ranks by anger will grow anger.
examples.trans: 按愤怒排名的平台会种植愤怒。

examples.sentence: They called it a platform and acted like a landlord.
examples.trans: 他们称之为平台，表现得像房东。

examples.sentence: Creators live on a platform they do not own.
examples.trans: 创作者活在他们并不拥有的平台上。

examples.sentence: A platform can be a stage or a trap, sometimes both before breakfast.
examples.trans: 平台可以是舞台或陷阱，有时早餐前两者都是。

occupation.usageZh: 名词：职业 / 占用 occupation as a teacher；the occupation of a seat。动词 occupy。

examples.sentence: Teaching is her occupation.
examples.trans: 教书是她的职业。

examples.sentence: His occupation is night packing.
examples.trans: 他的职业是夜间打包。

examples.sentence: The comment box occupied the whole evening.
examples.trans: 评论框占用了整个晚上。

examples.sentence: Occupational fatigue is not a personal brand.
examples.trans: 职业疲劳不是个人品牌。

examples.sentence: They asked for occupation and meant a pretty title.
examples.trans: 他们问职业，意思是漂亮头衔。

examples.sentence: An occupation that lives on likes will occupy sleep.
examples.trans: 靠赞活着的职业会占用睡眠。

renowned.usageZh: 形容词：著名的 a renowned teacher。名词 renown。

examples.sentence: She is a renowned cook.
examples.trans: 她是著名厨师。

examples.sentence: A renowned instructor still used a cheap mic.
examples.trans: 著名讲师仍用廉价麦克风。

examples.sentence: Renowned courses can still mislead on refunds.
examples.trans: 著名课程仍可能在退款上误导。

examples.sentence: They bought renowned names and rented the teaching.
examples.trans: 他们买下著名名字，再租出教学。

examples.sentence: Renown on a platform lasts until the algorithm turns.
examples.trans: 平台上的名望持续到算法转弯。

examples.sentence: A renowned thumbnail is not a renowned mind.
examples.trans: 著名缩略图不是著名头脑。

fragmented.usageZh: 形容词：碎片化的 fragmented attention。动词 fragment。名词 fragment。

examples.sentence: The glass is fragmented.
examples.trans: 玻璃碎了。

examples.sentence: Her evening felt fragmented by alerts.
examples.trans: 提醒把她的晚上切碎了。

examples.sentence: Fragmented attention cannot hold a long bus ride kindly.
examples.trans: 碎片化的注意力无法善意地撑过长车程。

examples.sentence: They prefer fragmented clips because leaving is harder.
examples.trans: 他们更爱碎片片段，因为离开更难。

examples.sentence: A fragmented public cannot vote on a whole timetable.
examples.trans: 碎片化的公众无法对完整时刻表投票。

examples.sentence: Fragmentation is a business model, not a personality.
examples.trans: 碎片化是商业模式，不是性格。

review.usageZh: 名词/动词：评论 write a review；review a film。

examples.sentence: Write a short review.
examples.trans: 写一段短评。

examples.sentence: She reviewed the course after the refund maze.
examples.trans: 退款迷宫之后她评论了课程。

examples.sentence: Five-star reviews arrived in a bundle.
examples.trans: 五星评论成捆到达。

examples.sentence: A review that cannot name the rider is incomplete.
examples.trans: 不能点名骑手的评论是不完整的。

examples.sentence: They deleted a review that mentioned the leak.
examples.trans: 他们删了提到泄漏的评论。

examples.sentence: To review is to leave a map for the next stranger.
examples.trans: 评论，就是给下一个陌生人留地图。

download.usageZh: 动词/名词：下载 download an app。反义 upload。

examples.sentence: Download the map first.
examples.trans: 先下载地图。

examples.sentence: The download failed on the train.
examples.trans: 火车上下载失败了。

examples.sentence: She downloaded a lecture and lost the file in a folder maze.
examples.trans: 她下载了讲座，把文件丢在文件夹迷宫里。

examples.sentence: A forced download before refund is a gate.
examples.trans: 退款前强制下载是一扇门。

examples.sentence: They counted downloads and not completed watches.
examples.trans: 他们数下载，不数看完。

examples.sentence: What you download at 1 a.m. still occupies the morning.
examples.trans: 凌晨一点下载的，仍会占用早晨。

instructor.usageZh: 名词：讲师 / 教练 a driving instructor。动词 instruct。

examples.sentence: Ask the instructor.
examples.trans: 问讲师。

examples.sentence: The instructor paused so we could drink water.
examples.trans: 讲师停下来让我们喝水。

examples.sentence: A renowned instructor still read from a fading slide.
examples.trans: 著名讲师仍对着褪色幻灯片读。

examples.sentence: They replaced the instructor with a clip that never blinked.
examples.trans: 他们用从不眨眼的片段替换讲师。

examples.sentence: Good instructors leave a way out of the maze.
examples.trans: 好讲师会留下走出迷宫的路。

examples.sentence: An instructor who cannot be questioned is only a recording.
examples.trans: 不能被提问的讲师只是录音。

negative.usageZh: 形容词：负面的 negative comments。

examples.sentence: Skip negative gossip.
examples.trans: 跳过负面闲话。

examples.sentence: A negative review named the hidden fee.
examples.trans: 差评点出了隐藏费用。

examples.sentence: They called questions about refunds 'negative energy'.
examples.trans: 他们把关于退款的问题叫做负能量。

examples.sentence: Negative space in a feed is where sleep could live.
examples.trans: 信息流里的负空间，是睡眠可以住的地方。

examples.sentence: A negative comment can be a map, not a mood.
examples.trans: 一条负面评论可以是地图，不是心情。

examples.sentence: If only positive reviews stay, the leak stays too.
examples.trans: 如果只留下好评，泄漏也会留下。

mislead.usageZh: 动词：误导 mislead customers。形容词 misleading。名词 misleader 少用。

examples.sentence: Do not mislead the buyer.
examples.trans: 不要误导买家。

examples.sentence: The thumbnail misled her about the length.
examples.trans: 缩略图在时长上误导了她。

examples.sentence: A misleading 'free' hid a monthly fee.
examples.trans: 误导性的“免费”藏着月费。

examples.sentence: They misled students with a renowned name and a rented teacher.
examples.trans: 他们用著名名字和租来的老师误导学生。

examples.sentence: To mislead at checkout is a design choice.
examples.trans: 在结账时误导是一种设计选择。

examples.sentence: Being misled at 1 a.m. still counts in the morning.
examples.trans: 凌晨一点被误导，早晨仍然算数。

blogger.usageZh: 名词：博主 a food blogger。名词 blog。动词 blog。

examples.sentence: The blogger tried the soup.
examples.trans: 博主试了汤。

examples.sentence: A travel blogger skipped the closed clinic.
examples.trans: 旅行博主跳过了关掉的诊所。

examples.sentence: Bloggers live on a platform's weather.
examples.trans: 博主活在平台的天气里。

examples.sentence: They paid bloggers for reviews and called it community.
examples.trans: 他们付钱给博主写评论，称之为社区。

examples.sentence: A blogger who names refunds may lose the next gift.
examples.trans: 点名退款的博主可能失去下一份礼物。

examples.sentence: Blogging without a way home is still night work.
examples.trans: 没有回家路的写博仍是夜班。

economy.usageZh: 名词：经济 the digital economy。形容词 economic。副词 economically。

examples.sentence: The town has a small economy.
examples.trans: 这座镇经济体量小。

examples.sentence: The attention economy eats dinner.
examples.trans: 注意力经济吃掉晚饭。

examples.sentence: A gig economy can look like freedom and feel like no last bus.
examples.trans: 零工经济看起来像自由，摸起来像没有末班车。

examples.sentence: They praised the digital economy and underpaid the rider.
examples.trans: 他们赞美数字经济，少付骑手。

examples.sentence: Economic growth that skips refunds is a screenshot.
examples.trans: 跳过退款的经济增长是截图。

examples.sentence: An economy of clicks still runs on knees and sleep.
examples.trans: 点击的经济仍跑在膝盖和睡眠上。

display.usageZh: 名词/动词：展示 a shop display；display a notice。

examples.sentence: Look at the display.
examples.trans: 看展示。

examples.sentence: The screen displayed a smaller price, then a larger one.
examples.trans: 屏幕先显示较小的价格，再显示较大的。

examples.sentence: A window display sold holidays and hid the hours.
examples.trans: 橱窗展示出售假期，藏起钟点。

examples.sentence: They displayed five stars and deleted the sixth comment.
examples.trans: 他们展示五星，删了第六条评论。

examples.sentence: What a platform displays is a choice about what you will not see.
examples.trans: 平台展示什么，就是选择你看不见什么。

examples.sentence: A display of kindness in an ad can still refuse a refund.
examples.trans: 广告里展示的善意仍可能拒绝退款。

profit.usageZh: 名词/动词：利润 make a profit；profit from clicks。形容词 profitable。

examples.sentence: The shop made a small profit.
examples.trans: 商店赚了一点利润。

examples.sentence: Who profits from a hidden unsubscribe?
examples.trans: 谁从隐藏的退订中获利？

examples.sentence: Night alerts are profitable; morning heads are not in the graph.
examples.trans: 夜间提醒有利可图；早晨的头不在图表里。

examples.sentence: They profited from fragmented attention.
examples.trans: 他们从碎片化注意力中获利。

examples.sentence: A profitable maze is still a maze for the buyer.
examples.trans: 有利可图的迷宫对买家仍是迷宫。

examples.sentence: Profit that cannot survive a clear refund is a kind of fog.
examples.trans: 经不起清楚退款的利润是一种雾。

broadcast.usageZh: 动词/名词：广播 broadcast a show。形容词 broadcast（过去分词同形）。

examples.sentence: They broadcast the match.
examples.trans: 他们转播了比赛。

examples.sentence: The station broadcast a flood warning late.
examples.trans: 电台晚了才广播洪水预警。

examples.sentence: A live broadcast still has an editor somewhere.
examples.trans: 直播仍有某个地方的编辑。

examples.sentence: They broadcast confidence and whispered the outage.
examples.trans: 他们广播自信，低声说起故障。

examples.sentence: What gets broadcast is not always what happened on the stairs.
examples.trans: 被广播的，不总是楼梯上发生的。

examples.sentence: A broadcast of joy at 1 a.m. can still be a labour schedule.
examples.trans: 凌晨一点的欢乐广播仍可能是一张劳动时间表。

abundant.usageZh: 形容词：丰富的 abundant data。名词 abundance。副词 abundantly。

examples.sentence: Fruit is abundant here.
examples.trans: 这里水果丰富。

examples.sentence: Abundant data still missed the leak.
examples.trans: 丰富的数据仍错过了泄漏。

examples.sentence: Abundant content can starve a long thought.
examples.trans: 丰富的内容能饿死一个长念头。

examples.sentence: They promised abundant choice and offered one ranking.
examples.trans: 他们承诺丰富选择，只提供一个排名。

examples.sentence: Abundance of alerts is not abundance of care.
examples.trans: 提醒的丰富不是照护的丰富。

examples.sentence: An abundant feed can make a scarce night.
examples.trans: 丰富的信息流可以造成稀缺的夜晚。

opportunity.usageZh: 名词：机会 an opportunity to learn。形容词 opportune。

examples.sentence: This is a good opportunity.
examples.trans: 这是个好机会。

examples.sentence: The free trial was an opportunity with a calendar trap.
examples.trans: 免费试用是带着日历陷阱的机会。

examples.sentence: Night courses can be an opportunity and a stolen morning.
examples.trans: 夜间课程可以是机会，也可以是被偷的早晨。

examples.sentence: They sold opportunity and rented the instructor.
examples.trans: 他们出售机会，租用讲师。

examples.sentence: An opportunity that cannot be refused is pressure.
examples.trans: 无法拒绝的机会是压力。

examples.sentence: Opportunity without a refund is just a brighter maze.
examples.trans: 没有退款的机会，只是更亮的迷宫。

with the development of.usageZh: 介词短语：随着……的发展 with the development of sth。

examples.sentence: With the development of bikes, the hill felt smaller.
examples.trans: 随着自行车的发展，山显得小了。

examples.sentence: With the development of cheap data, dinners got quieter.
examples.trans: 随着便宜流量的发展，晚饭更安静了。

examples.sentence: With the development of platforms, instructors became clips.
examples.trans: 随着平台发展，讲师变成了片段。

examples.sentence: With the development of one-click purchase, refunds hid.
examples.trans: 随着一键购买的发展，退款藏起来了。

examples.sentence: With the development of attention markets, sleep became a bug.
examples.trans: 随着注意力市场的发展，睡眠成了故障。

examples.sentence: With the development of anything fast, someone still walks at dawn.
examples.trans: 随着任何快速事物的发展，仍有人黎明走路。

as long as.usageZh: 连词：只要 as long as + 从句。

examples.sentence: Stay as long as you need.
examples.trans: 你需要多久就待多久。

examples.sentence: As long as the refund works, I will try the course.
examples.trans: 只要退款能用，我就试这课。

examples.sentence: As long as the rider is unpaid, the price is a story.
examples.trans: 只要骑手没被付足，价格就是故事。

examples.sentence: You can scroll as long as you like; morning still comes.
examples.trans: 你可以想滚多久就多久；早晨仍会来。

examples.sentence: As long as the maze remains, convenience is a slogan.
examples.trans: 只要迷宫还在，方便就是口号。

examples.sentence: Keep the paper number as long as the app can vanish.
examples.trans: 只要应用可能消失，就留着纸上的号码。

keen on.usageZh: 形容词短语：热衷于 be keen on sth/doing。

examples.sentence: She is keen on maps.
examples.trans: 她热衷于地图。

examples.sentence: He is keen on night courses and less keen on dawn.
examples.trans: 他热衷夜间课程，对黎明不那么热衷。

examples.sentence: They are keen on reviews they can pin.
examples.trans: 他们热衷于能置顶的评论。

examples.sentence: Being keen on a platform is not the same as owning it.
examples.trans: 热衷于平台不等于拥有它。

examples.sentence: Kids keen on streaks may be keen on a designed hook.
examples.trans: 热衷连续天数的孩子，可能热衷于设计好的钩子。

examples.sentence: Keen on convenience, they forgot the rider.
examples.trans: 热衷方便，他们忘了骑手。

at a ... price.usageZh: 名词短语：以……的价格 at a high/low/fair price。

examples.sentence: Rice is at a fair price.
examples.trans: 米价公道。

examples.sentence: The course is at a low price until month two.
examples.trans: 这课在第二个月之前价格低。

examples.sentence: Convenience arrives at a hidden price.
examples.trans: 方便以隐藏的价格到达。

examples.sentence: They advertised at a student price and charged a worker price.
examples.trans: 他们按学生价广告，按工人价收费。

examples.sentence: Attention is sold at a second-by-second price.
examples.trans: 注意力按秒计价出售。

examples.sentence: A refund at a fair price is rarer than a thumbnail.
examples.trans: 公道价格的退款比缩略图更罕见。

on most occasions.usageZh: 状语：在大多数情况下 on most occasions。

examples.sentence: On most occasions the bus is late.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下车会晚。

examples.sentence: On most occasions the app works until you need a human.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下应用能用，直到你需要人。

examples.sentence: On most occasions the five stars were bought.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下五星是买来的。

examples.sentence: On most occasions night delivery is a knee story.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下夜间配送是膝盖的故事。

examples.sentence: On most occasions 'free' is a calendar.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下“免费”是一本日历。

examples.sentence: On most occasions the official notice arrives after the street knows.
examples.trans: 大多数情况下官方通知在街上知道之后才到。

fond of.usageZh: 形容词短语：喜欢 be fond of sb/sth。

examples.sentence: She is fond of tea.
examples.trans: 她喜欢茶。

examples.sentence: He is fond of long lectures on the train.
examples.trans: 他喜欢火车上的长讲座。

examples.sentence: They are fond of attractive thumbnails.
examples.trans: 他们喜欢吸引人的缩略图。

examples.sentence: Being fond of a blogger is not a contract.
examples.trans: 喜欢博主不是合同。

examples.sentence: Platforms are fond of users who cannot leave.
examples.trans: 平台喜欢无法离开的用户。

examples.sentence: Fond of convenience, the town forgot the last office hour.
examples.trans: 喜欢方便，镇子忘了最后一个办公小时。

in that case.usageZh: 连接性状语：既然那样 in that case。

examples.sentence: In that case, wait here.
examples.trans: 既然那样，就在这里等。

examples.sentence: The download failed. In that case, use the paper map.
examples.trans: 下载失败了。既然那样，用纸地图。

examples.sentence: The refund hid. In that case, keep the email.
examples.trans: 退款藏起来了。既然那样，留着邮件。

examples.sentence: In that case the 'free' trial is a trap.
examples.trans: 既然那样，免费试用就是陷阱。

examples.sentence: The instructor is a clip. In that case, ask who answers questions.
examples.trans: 讲师是片段。既然那样，问谁回答问题。

examples.sentence: In that case, sleep is the refund you still own.
examples.trans: 既然那样，睡眠是你仍拥有的退款。

examples.sentence: Book in advance.
examples.trans: 提前预订。

examples.sentence: Pay in advance and the maze begins.
examples.trans: 提前付款，迷宫就开始了。

examples.sentence: They wanted reviews in advance of the meal.
examples.trans: 他们想在饭前拿到评论。

examples.sentence: Download the lecture in advance; the train wifi dies.
examples.trans: 提前下载讲座；火车无线网会死。

examples.sentence: Insurance in advance is cheaper than a storm screenshot.
examples.trans: 提前买保险比风暴截图便宜。

examples.sentence: Warning in advance is a kind of refund for attention.
examples.trans: 提前警告是注意力的一种退款。

log on to.usageZh: 短语动词：登录 log on to a site。也作 log in。

examples.sentence: Log on to the class page.
examples.trans: 登录到课程页。

examples.sentence: She logged on to the bank at dawn.
examples.trans: 她黎明登录银行。

examples.sentence: He cannot log on to the refund page from the phone.
examples.trans: 他无法从手机登录退款页。

examples.sentence: Logging on to a platform is easy; logging off is designed hard.
examples.trans: 登录平台容易；退出被设计得很难。

examples.sentence: They asked us to log on to watch a video we already paid for.
examples.trans: 他们让我们登录去看已经付过钱的视频。

examples.sentence: If you cannot log on to a human, the service is a recording.
examples.trans: 如果你登录不到一个人，服务就是录音。

as for.usageZh: 介词短语：至于 as for sb/sth。

examples.sentence: As for me, I will walk.
examples.trans: 至于我，我会走路。

examples.sentence: As for the refund, it is still a maze.
examples.trans: 至于退款，它仍是迷宫。

examples.sentence: As for the rider, nobody named the knees.
examples.trans: 至于骑手，没人点名膝盖。

examples.sentence: As for attention, the thumbnail already ate dinner.
examples.trans: 至于注意力，缩略图已经吃掉了晚饭。

examples.sentence: As for official news, the street knew first.
examples.trans: 至于官方消息，街上先知道。

examples.sentence: As for sleep, the streak called it a bug.
examples.trans: 至于睡眠，连续天数把它叫做故障。

gained attention.usageZh: 动词短语：获得关注 gain attention。

examples.sentence: The poster gained attention.
examples.trans: 海报获得了关注。

examples.sentence: The leak gained attention only after a blogger named it.
examples.trans: 泄漏在博主点名后才获得关注。

examples.sentence: Cheap anger gained attention faster than a long review.
examples.trans: 廉价愤怒比长评更快获得关注。

examples.sentence: They gained attention with a renowned name and a rented teacher.
examples.trans: 他们用著名名字和租来的老师获得关注。

examples.sentence: A flood warning should gain attention before a dance clip.
examples.trans: 洪水预警应在舞蹈片段之前获得关注。

examples.sentence: What gained attention at 1 a.m. may cost the morning.
examples.trans: 凌晨一点获得关注的，可能让早晨付出代价。

regard as.usageZh: 动词短语：把……视为 regard sb/sth as。

examples.sentence: I regard her as a guide.
examples.trans: 我视她为向导。

examples.sentence: They regard clicks as proof of learning.
examples.trans: 他们把点击视为学习的证据。

examples.sentence: The platform is regarded as a landlord.
examples.trans: 这平台被视为房东。

examples.sentence: Do not regard a streak as health.
examples.trans: 不要把连续天数视为健康。

examples.sentence: Riders are regarded as weather, not as knees.
examples.trans: 骑手被视为天气，而不是膝盖。

examples.sentence: What we regard as free is often a calendar.
examples.trans: 我们视为免费的，常常是一本日历。

make use of.usageZh: 动词短语：利用 make use of sth。

examples.sentence: Make use of the paper map.
examples.trans: 利用纸地图。

examples.sentence: She made use of the free hour before the fee.
examples.trans: 她在收费前利用了免费的一小时。

examples.sentence: They make use of fragmented evenings.
examples.trans: 他们利用碎片化的晚上。

examples.sentence: Make use of a human if the app maze grows.
examples.trans: 应用迷宫变大时，利用一个人。

examples.sentence: Platforms make use of attention they did not grow.
examples.trans: 平台利用他们并未种植的注意力。

examples.sentence: To make use of a refund button, you must first find it.
examples.trans: 要利用退款按钮，你得先找到它。

hot topic.usageZh: 名词短语：热门话题 a hot topic。

examples.sentence: Water is a hot topic here.
examples.trans: 水在这里是热门话题。

examples.sentence: Refunds became a hot topic after the crash.
examples.trans: 崩溃之后退款成了热门话题。

examples.sentence: A hot topic on a platform may be cold on the stairs.
examples.trans: 平台上的热门话题在楼梯上可能是冷的。

examples.sentence: They turned the leak into a hot topic and not into a repair.
examples.trans: 他们把泄漏变成热门话题，而不是修理。

examples.sentence: Sleep is rarely a hot topic because it cannot shout.
examples.trans: 睡眠很少成为热门话题，因为它不能喊。

examples.sentence: A hot topic that cannot name hours is entertainment.
examples.trans: 不能点名钟点的热门话题是娱乐。

renowned teachers.usageZh: 名词短语：名师 renowned teachers。

examples.sentence: The school hired renowned teachers.
examples.trans: 学校雇了名师。

examples.sentence: Renowned teachers still need water and a pause.
examples.trans: 名师仍需要水和停顿。

examples.sentence: They sold renowned teachers and delivered a clip.
examples.trans: 他们出售名师，交付一段片段。

examples.sentence: A list of renowned teachers can be a rented catalogue.
examples.trans: 名师名单可以是租来的目录。

examples.sentence: Renowned teachers on a thumbnail may never answer a question.
examples.trans: 缩略图上的名师可能从不回答问题。

examples.sentence: If renowned teachers cannot be reached, the course is a broadcast.
examples.trans: 如果名师联系不上，这课就是广播。

by themselves.usageZh: 状语：独自 / 亲自 by themselves。

examples.sentence: The kids waited by themselves.
examples.trans: 孩子们自己等着。

examples.sentence: The app will not refund by itself.
examples.trans: 应用不会自行退款。

examples.sentence: Riders cannot fix the map by themselves.
examples.trans: 骑手无法独自修好地图。

examples.sentence: Students left by themselves in a maze will buy the next course.
examples.trans: 被独自留在迷宫里的学生会买下一门课。

examples.sentence: A platform does not care by itself; people inside it decide.
examples.trans: 平台不会自行在乎；里面的人决定。

examples.sentence: Reviews do not become honest by themselves.
examples.trans: 评论不会自行变得诚实。

no matter where.usageZh: 让步短语：无论在哪里 no matter where。

examples.sentence: Call me no matter where you are.
examples.trans: 无论你在哪都给我打电话。

examples.sentence: No matter where you click, the fee waits.
examples.trans: 无论你点哪里，费用都在等。

examples.sentence: No matter where the office moved, the maze stayed.
examples.trans: 无论办公室搬到哪，迷宫还在。

examples.sentence: The rider works no matter where the pin drops.
examples.trans: 无论图钉落在哪，骑手都在工作。

examples.sentence: No matter where you watch, someone edited the pause.
examples.trans: 无论你在哪看，都有人剪过停顿。

examples.sentence: No matter where the platform lives, sleep still has an address.
examples.trans: 无论平台住在哪，睡眠仍有地址。

are against.usageZh: 动词短语：反对 be against sth。

examples.sentence: They are against wet wires.
examples.trans: 他们反对湿电线。

examples.sentence: Parents are against streaks that eat dinner.
examples.trans: 父母反对吃掉晚饭的连续天数。

examples.sentence: Riders are against maps that lie.
examples.trans: 骑手反对会撒谎的地图。

examples.sentence: If you are against hidden fees, keep the email.
examples.trans: 如果你反对隐藏费用，留着邮件。

examples.sentence: The street is against a platform that will not refund.
examples.trans: 这条街反对不肯退款的平台。

examples.sentence: Being against a maze is easier than finding the door.
examples.trans: 反对迷宫比找到门容易。

cut down the price.usageZh: 动词短语：降价 cut down the price / cut the price。

examples.sentence: They cut down the price at closing.
examples.trans: 打烊时他们降了价。

examples.sentence: The site cut down the price and hid the monthly fee.
examples.trans: 网站降了价，藏起月费。

examples.sentence: Cut down the price of the course, not the instructor's pause.
examples.trans: 降低课程价格，不是讲师的停顿。

examples.sentence: They cut down the price of delivery by cutting the rider.
examples.trans: 他们靠削减骑手来降低配送价格。

examples.sentence: A thumbnail can cut down the price of truth.
examples.trans: 缩略图能降低真相的价格。

examples.sentence: If you only cut down the price, the maze stays full price.
examples.trans: 如果你只降价，迷宫仍是全价。

win-win pattern.usageZh: 名词短语：双赢模式 a win-win pattern。

examples.sentence: They called it a win-win pattern.
examples.trans: 他们称之为双赢模式。

examples.sentence: A win-win pattern that skips refunds is a win-lose maze.
examples.trans: 跳过退款的双赢模式是赢-输迷宫。

examples.sentence: The ad showed a win-win pattern; the rider showed knees.
examples.trans: 广告展示双赢模式；骑手展示膝盖。

examples.sentence: Win-win patterns on slides rarely include sleep.
examples.trans: 幻灯片上的双赢模式很少包括睡眠。

examples.sentence: If only the platform wins, it is not a win-win pattern.
examples.trans: 如果只有平台赢，那就不是双赢模式。

examples.sentence: A true win-win pattern leaves a door, a chair, and a refund.
examples.trans: 真正的双赢模式留下门、椅子和退款。

grammar.title: 被动语态（一般过去）
grammar.usage: 一般过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词，强调承受者。The door was locked. 施动者用 by。否定 was not done。情态过去 could be done。高中：It was said that...；过去完成被动 had been done。
forms: Was/Were + 主语 + 过去分词？
notes: 主语是承受者。
by 短语可省略。
不规则动词要用过去分词 written/done/gone。
were 接复数。
有具体过去时间仍用过去被动，不用现在完成被动。

examples.en: The door was locked at nine.
examples.cn: 门在九点被锁上。

examples.en: The logins were packed by Mina.
examples.cn: 杯子是丽娜洗的。

examples.en: The extra shift was not paid.
examples.cn: 加班没有付工资。

examples.en: The reserved seats were declared, then ignored.
examples.cn: 休息日被宣布，然后被忽略。

grammar.title: 现在完成时
grammar.usage: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，连接过去与现在。They have gone through a hard year。标志词 already/yet/just/ever/never/for/since。对比一般过去：有具体过去时间用过去时。高中：完成进行 have been doing；被动 have been done。
forms: for + 时段 / since + 起点
have/has been + 过去分词（被动）
notes: He has 不是 He have。
短暂动词不宜接 for：改用 been here。
yesterday 用过去时。
since 接起点，for 接时段。
疑问 Have you ever...？

exercises.q: She ____ packed the logins.

选择正确句子。
We have not eaten ____.
Tom ____ (have) lost his key.
After she has ____ (eat), she will rest.
I have ____ (just / arrive).
现在完成由 have/has + 过去分词构成。
He have gone 正确。
碗是空的。她已经洗了。→ She ____ the logins.
否定：They have started. → They have not started ____.
After he ____ (finish), he will sleep.
改错：She have packed.
改错：He has go home.
They ____ through a hard month.
____ you ever waited for a morning feed?
She has already ____ the apology.
We have lived here ____ 2019.
He has been tired ____ two weeks.
They have ____ (lock) the door.
I have not seen her ____ Monday.
____ you packed yet?
since 接起点，for 接时段。
He has arrived for two hours 很自然。
经历：They went through a hard year, and it still shows. → They ____ a hard year.
since：她从早上就在等。She ____ since morning.
already：We packed. → We have ____ packed.
改错：They has gone through a hard month.
exercises.answer: They have gone through a hard month.

exercises.q: 改错：He has arrived for two hours.
exercises.answer: He has been here for two hours.

exercises.q: Many families have ____ delay that was called safety.
Once they have ____ an understanding, complaining drops.
She has never ____ a front-row thumbnail.
____ having named the fear, they slept.
The statistics have ____ the platforms.
When the rain has ____ (stop), we will walk.
She has ____ (be) waiting all week.
After they have eaten, they ____ (talk).
after having done 是书面结构。
有 yesterday 仍必须用现在完成。
once：You name the fear. Then you rest. → Once you ____ the fear, rest.
完成进行：她一上午都在等公交。She ____ for the bus all morning.
after having：They cooked. Then they talked. → After ____, they talked.
改错：They have suffer from delay.
改错：The board has signed yesterday.
Long loading bars have ____ in the report.
The family has not slept ____.
Inspectors have waited ____ dawn.
She has been ____ the morning feed since ten.
Once the reserved seats have been ____, workers can actually rest.
After they have posted the hours, trust ____ (return).
The clause has ____ (remain) paper.
____ having sealed the door, they waited.
时间从句里的现在完成可指向将来已完成。
有明确过去时间仍必须用现在完成。
被动：They ignore long loading bars. It still shows. → Long loading bars ____ in the report.
完成进行：从十点起一直在等。She ____ since ten.
for/since：两周了。He has been tired ____ two weeks.
改错：Long loading bars have ignored in the report.
exercises.answer: Long loading bars have been ignored in the report.

exercises.q: 改错：They have gone through it last March.
exercises.answer: They went through it last March.

exercises.q: Night streams have continued ____ two winters.
We have already ____ whose hours vanished.
Until the missing bus ____, delay stood still.
They have been ____ the delay rather than naming it.
After having ____ the totals, they published a neat page.
Once enforcement has ____ (move), slogans mean something.
The street has not slept ____ night streams arrived.
They have been ____ (share) the heavy hours.
lie 的过去分词是 lain。
after having done 不能带宾语。
once 被动：They fund reserved seats. Then people rest. → Once reserved seats ____, people can rest.
after having：They hid the delay. Then they lost trust. → After ____ the delay, they lost trust.

grammar.title: 真实条件句（第一类）
grammar.usage: 第一类条件句谈真实可能的将来：If + 一般现在时, 主句 will / be going to / 情态 / 祈使。肯定：If you stay keen, you will improve. 否定：If you don't practise, it isn't going to happen。If 从句不用 will。unless = if ... not。as long as / provided that 也可引导真实条件。初中：时态搭配。高中：should you need（倒装）、祈使+and/or。
forms: If + 现在时, 主语 + will / be going to + 原形
If + 现在时, 祈使句（If you see her, tell her.）
Unless + 现在时, 主句（= if ... not）
If + 现在时, 情态 can/may/must/should
祈使句 + and / or + 将来结果
Should + 主语 + 原形, 主句 will（书面倒装）
notes: If 从句用现在时表将来，避免 if it will rain。
unless 本身含否定，不再加 don't：unless you hurry，不是 unless you don't hurry（除非有意双重否定）。
be going to 强调基于现状的后果。
主句可以是祈使：If the oil smokes, turn the heat down.
provided that / as long as 强调“唯一需要满足的条件”。

exercises.q: If it ____, we will stay inside.

选择正确句子。
options: If she is free, she will come.
If she will be free, she comes.
If she free, she will come.
If she is free, she coming.
exercises.answer: If she is free, she will come.

exercises.q: If the soup is hot, ____ it slowly.
If Tom ____ (finish) early, he will help us.
If you don't hurry, you ____ miss the start.
If the light is red, ____ (stop).
If 从句里要用 will 表示将来。
“If you see him, tell him.” 是正确的。
用 if 连接：It rains. We stay inside. → If it rains, we ____ inside.
改成否定条件：If you hurry, you will catch it. → If you ____ hurry, you will miss it.
改成祈使主句：If the milk boils, you will turn it down. → If the milk boils, ____ it down.
改错：If it will rain, we stay.
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will stay.

exercises.q: 改错：If she have time, she will come.
exercises.answer: If she has time, she will come.

exercises.q: Unless you ____ the gate, the tabs will leave.
If he doesn't practise, it ____ going to happen.
Take a map ____ you will get lost.
If the ice looks thin, you ____ stay off it.
____ you finish, we can leave.
Unless it ____ (stop) raining, we will wait.
Bring a coat ____ you will feel cold.
If they are hungry, they ____ (can / eat) first.
unless 相当于 if ... not。
“Unless you don't lock it” 是最自然的说法。
exercises.explain: 双重否定别扭，用 If you don't lock 或 Unless you lock。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't water it, it will die. → Unless you ____ it, it will die.
用 and 连接：Hurry up. You will catch it. → Hurry up ____ you will catch it.
If she ____ (not be) careful, she will drop it.
改错：Unless you will hurry, you miss it.
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss it.

exercises.q: 改错：If you will see her, tell her.
exercises.answer: If you see her, tell her.

exercises.q: As long as the radio ____, we can ask for a boat.
If the feed refreshes tonight, the servers ____ flood.
Provided that you ____ a torch, the path is safe.
Should you need help, you ____ ring the bell.
If you can't stay keen, it is never ____ happen.
If the oil smokes, ____ the heat down.
You will not improve unless you ____ (stay) keen.
Should the lights fail, we ____ use the stairs.
第一类条件可以在主句用 be going to。
provided that 引导的从句要用 will。
用 as long as 改写：If you have internet, there are resources. → As long as you ____ internet, there are resources.
用 unless 改写：If you don't stay keen, it will not happen. → Unless you ____ keen, it will not happen.
Should 倒装：If you need water, call us. → Should you ____ water, call us.
改错：If you will not stay keen, it never happens.
exercises.answer: If you don't stay keen, it is never going to happen. / If you don't stay keen, it will never happen.

exercises.q: 改错：Provided that you will bring a torch, we go.
exercises.answer: Provided that you bring a torch, we will go.

exercises.q: If the sensors are not calibrated, the dashboard ____ elegant lies.
Unless inspectors ____ on Monday, the clause is paper.
Should the cable fail, the city ____ go dark.
Give them the raw files ____ trust will follow.
If a family cannot afford private lessons, distance education ____ still help.

exercises.q: Should + 主语 + 原形 可以替代 if 真实条件，语气更书面。
第一类条件主句不能使用 can 或 may。
用 unless 改写：If the board does not see the numbers, it will not sign. → Unless the board ____ the numbers, it will not sign.
倒装：If you need the archive, write ahead. → Should you ____ the archive, write ahead.
用 going to 强调后果：If you hide the leak, it ____ get worse.
改错：If the river will rise, the servers flood.
exercises.answer: If the feed refreshes, the servers will flood.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless they will arrive, wait.
If access is sold as privilege, knowledge ____ like a gated park.
The talks will stall unless both maps ____ on one table.
Should night deliveries continue, the street ____ not sleep.
Calibrate the sensors ____ the dashboard will stop lying.
If the intern answers without checking, the client ____ still quote the number.
If shade is treated as decoration, summers ____ punish walkers.

provided that 与 as long as 都可以引导充分条件。
真实条件的倒装必须用 Had + 过去分词。
exercises.explain: 那是对过去的虚拟；真实将来用 Should + 原形。

exercises.q: 用 should 倒装：If the audit finds gaps, pause. → Should the audit ____ gaps, pause.
用 unless 改写：If we do not post raw files, trust will thin. → Unless we ____ raw files, trust will thin.
祈使 + or：Name the delay. You will lose the room. → Name the delay ____ you will lose the room.
改错：If inspectors will arrive, the treaty lives.
exercises.answer: If inspectors arrive, the treaty will live. / If inspectors arrive, the treaty lives as a general truth.

exercises.q: 改错：Should the cable failed, the city goes dark.
exercises.answer: Should the cable fail, the city will go dark.

第一类条件可以描述制度性的真实后果，不必谈个人日程。
exercises.explain: 语法管的是可能性，不是话题。

exercises.q: Unless 从句在书面语里必须倒装。
倒装：If the treaty lacks inspectors, it remains paper. → Should the treaty ____ inspectors, it will remain paper.
unless 被动：If the sensors are not calibrated, the dashboard lies. → Unless the sensors ____, the dashboard will lie.

改错：If access will be sold as privilege, knowledge looks gated.
exercises.answer: If access is sold as privilege, knowledge will look gated.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless demand will be recalibrated, the model bankrupts the plan.
exercises.answer: Unless demand is recalibrated, the model will bankrupt the plan.

grammar.title: 比较结构
grammar.usage: 叠用比较级表单一趋势：noisier and noisier / more and more tired。对比 the more..., the more... 连接两个变化。less and less 递减。fewer and fewer + 可数。
notes: 不要 more and more louder。
people 用 more and more people。
fewer 接可数。
可与 become/get 连用。
不要和 the more 句型零件混用。

forms: after / when / once / as soon as + 现在完成时, 主句
for + 时段 / since + 起点
after having + 过去分词（分词短语）

already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
短暂动词可完成但不宜接 for 一段时间：不要 He has arrived for two hours，改用 been here。
after having done 更书面。

grammar.title: 定语从句 which/that
grammar.usage: that 引导限制性定语从句，指人/物，作主语或宾语；作宾语可省。物也可用 which；人用 who/whom/that。介词后不用 that，用 which/whom。不定代词、最高级、the only 后多用 that。高中：that 不可引导非限制性（逗号后用 which/who）。
notes: that 前一般不加逗号。
介词后不用 that。
the only/first/最高级后常用 that。
that 不能放在非限制性从句。
whose 表所属。

grammar.titleEn: Concession with even though / although / despite
grammar.usage: even though 引导让步：Even though the app is pretty, the refund hides。though / although 近义；even though 语气更强。even if 表假设让步。despite / in spite of + 名词/动名词。高中：倒装 Though it be...；while 也可让步。
forms: Even though / Although / Though + 从句
despite / in spite of + 名词/doing
不能 even though + 名词
notes: even though 后接完整句子，不接名词。
despite 后不接 that 从句（口语有人用，考试避免）。
although 不与 but 连用。
even if 谈未发生或不管是否。
though 可放句末：The refund hid, though。
